positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Newark, New Jersey, United States · Hybrid

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Maintains and creates new functionality for the backend microservices of Zelle, the person-to-person money transfer service, written in Java Spring Boot, and deployed on Amazon Web Services, utilizing the full software development lifecycle.  Also supports lambdas written in Node.js.  Other duties include on-call support shifts to respond to production issues, and addressing problems other teams are having with our services.  Collaborates with and helps others on a daily basis.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed and maintained a Linux based record keeping application written in Progress OpenEdge for Luxembourg offshore mutual funds, supporting assets under management of over $100 billion. Involved in all aspects of software development cycle, including application and database design, coding, debugging, and testing. Utilized Java for some projects. The system keeps track of client accounts, generates reports, allows manual and automated trade entry, and interfaces with other systems.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Developed and maintained an ERP Windows application for the packaging/box industry using Progress 4GL.  The application assisted companies in areas such as estimating, purchasing, inventory, order entry, and accounting.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Developed and maintained an ERP Windows application for the chemical industry using Progress 4GL. The application helped clients with inventory, order entry, invoicing, accounting, purchasing, and materials management.

positions.title: Summer Internship
positions.description: Contributed to Reuter's first Web-based news application by coding in JavaScript, VBScript, and XML.  Tested existing code and set up Windows 2000 servers.
